errors.actual:
"# Glycolysis: From Glucose to Pyruvate

Glycolysis begins with **one glucose molecule** and splits its six-carbon structure into **two pyruvate molecules**. Each pyruvate contains three carbons, so the carbon atoms are divided evenly:

$$1\\text{ glucose} \\rightarrow 2\\text{ pyruvate}$$

As this breakdown occurs, some of glucose’s stored chemical energy is captured in two useful forms:

- **2 NADH**, which are energy-carrying molecules
- A **net gain of 2 ATP**, which cells can use directly for energy

The complete yield per glucose is therefore:

$$1\\text{ glucose} \\rightarrow 2\\text{ pyruvate} + 2\\text{ NADH} + \\text{net }2\\text{ ATP}$$
